cycle.transportMethod: Distributed Darcy/HEOS homogeneous-equilibrium field lines; generic smooth copper, no slip/fittings/oil

warnings: Generic component parameters and control assumptions; not manufacturer calibrated.
Outdoor metal and retained water/ice share one equilibrium temperature.
Ice sublimation is excluded; retained ice melts or receives deposition.

Dirt scales air flow and air-side conductance at fixed fan command. Generic inverter indoor fans command 25–100% airflow across the thermostat band, linear air-side conductance and cubic electric power; no measured fan map.
Pipe model assumes smooth copper, homogeneous two-phase flow and outdoor ambient along the whole field line; slip, fittings and oil are excluded.

Idealized parallel indoor coils use generic demand-proportional flow for inverter operation, normalized 5% UA reserve for calling inverter branches and UA allocation for fixed-speed/defrost, and actual branch outlets; the mixed header meets the shared outlet target. Physical field-line heating retains per-branch subcooling control.
Generic inverter startup, ramp, envelope supervision and restart dwell override demand; stopped forecasts are control estimates, not sensor states.
Interzone openings use a buoyancy-informed sensible equivalent with reference air density 1.2 kg/m³ and cp 1006 J/(kg K); no inter-room air/water transport or resolved stratification.
Internal gains are prescribed sensible heat supplied to room air, separate from HVAC output and COP.

scope: Actual unchanged owner default, only visible requested-speed control changed to50x;1200s uninterrupted compressor after first valid cycle, no injected states or watts
